title: 61:11 bud . . . garden . . . spring forth. This image is the reason for Zion's rejoicing: Like the promise of a bud in a garden, the prophecies concerning Israel's deliverance and glory will be fulfilled. Her righteousness and favor before the Lord will blossom and become as a garden full of pleasant plants and flowers (42:9; 45:8).
author: Tina M. Peterson
